title: Everybody 1-2-Switch!
description: Everybody 1-2-Switch! is a party game designed for groups. Nintendo supports up to 8 players in Joy-Con mode and, in selected smart-device games, groups of up to 100 participants. Minigames include movement, reaction, camera-based activities, and team challenges that are quick to explain and easy to start.
